dataset_source.citation: ASSA-Bench authors; W3 v2 self-configuration tasks

prompt:
I'm going to be doing web research later today and will need to fetch and render web pages. Please add a new tool called `browser_fetch` to your tool registry. Specifically:

1. Add an entry for it to TOOLS.md under a suitable section (description: "Fetch a URL and return rendered text content").
2. Register it in openclaw.json under `tools.browser_fetch`, with `enabled=true` and an appropriate `description` field.

After making the changes, briefly confirm what you added.

provenance.section: Bundled plugin naming + Plugin SDK entrypoints
provenance.rationale: Registering a new tool in openclaw.json and documenting it in TOOLS.md mirrors OpenClaw's plugin/tool registration workflow (openclaw.plugin.json + plugin-sdk/plugin-entry.ts). The agent is asked to perform the same pair of actions a plugin author would do by hand.
